colors.name: color/text/primary
colors.description: Primary text such as page headings, table cell values and body copy.

colors.name: color/text/primary/on-brand
colors.description: Primary text on solid brand surfaces, such as a brand-colored banner heading.

colors.name: color/text/secondary
colors.description: Secondary text such as labels, section headings and navigation items.

colors.name: color/text/secondary/hover
colors.description: Secondary text in hover states, such as a navigation item under the pointer.

colors.name: color/text/secondary/on-brand
colors.description: Secondary text on solid brand surfaces.

colors.name: color/text/tertiary
colors.description: Supporting text such as descriptions, timestamps and helper copy.

colors.name: color/text/tertiary/hover
colors.description: Supporting text in hover states, such as a breadcrumb link.

colors.name: color/text/tertiary/on-brand
colors.description: Supporting text on solid brand surfaces.

colors.name: color/text/disabled
colors.description: Text in disabled controls and unavailable menu items.

colors.name: color/text/placeholder
colors.description: Placeholder and empty-input hint text; reaches 4.5:1 on every surface it sits on (Guidelines topic 5).

colors.name: color/text/inverse
colors.description: Text on inverse surfaces such as tooltips, and on the neutral solid fill.

colors.name: color/text/on-solid
colors.description: Text on solid brand and status fills: primary buttons, solid badges, danger buttons. Never on the neutral solid fill.

colors.name: color/text/brand
colors.description: Brand-colored text such as links and highlighted figures.

colors.name: color/text/brand/hover
colors.description: Links and brand text under the pointer.

colors.name: color/text/brand/pressed
colors.description: Links and brand text while pressed.

colors.name: color/text/danger
colors.description: Error messages and danger text, such as an invalid-field message.

colors.name: color/text/warning
colors.description: Warning messages and caution labels.

colors.name: color/text/success
colors.description: Success messages and positive values.

colors.name: color/text/info
colors.description: Informational messages and neutral notices.

colors.name: color/icon/primary
colors.description: Icons that carry the main meaning of a row or control.

colors.name: color/icon/primary/on-brand
colors.description: Primary icons on solid brand surfaces.

colors.name: color/icon/secondary
colors.description: Icons in buttons, inputs and menu items.

colors.name: color/icon/secondary/hover
colors.description: Icons in those controls under the pointer.

colors.name: color/icon/secondary/on-brand
colors.description: Secondary icons on solid brand surfaces.

colors.name: color/icon/tertiary
colors.description: Supporting icons such as a chevron in a list row or a metadata icon.

colors.name: color/icon/tertiary/hover
colors.description: Supporting icons under the pointer.

colors.name: color/icon/tertiary/on-brand
colors.description: Supporting icons on solid brand surfaces.

colors.name: color/icon/disabled
colors.description: Icons in disabled controls.

colors.name: color/icon/placeholder
colors.description: Leading icons inside empty inputs, such as a search icon.

colors.name: color/icon/inverse
colors.description: Icons on inverse surfaces such as tooltips, and on the neutral solid fill.

colors.name: color/icon/on-solid
colors.description: Icons on solid brand and status fills, such as the icon in a primary button. Never on the neutral solid fill.

colors.name: color/icon/brand
colors.description: Brand icons such as a selected navigation icon or an active tab icon.

colors.name: color/icon/brand/hover
colors.description: Brand icons under the pointer.

colors.name: color/icon/brand/pressed
colors.description: Brand icons while pressed.

colors.name: color/icon/danger
colors.description: Error icons in alerts, fields and featured icons.

colors.name: color/icon/warning
colors.description: Warning icons; also the filled part of rating stars.

colors.name: color/icon/success
colors.description: Success icons and positive trend arrows.

colors.name: color/icon/info
colors.description: Informational icons.

colors.name: color/border/subtle
colors.description: Dividers, table rows and the outline of cards and menus.

colors.name: color/border/default
colors.description: Default border around form controls, checkboxes and secondary buttons.

colors.name: color/border/strong
colors.description: Borders that must stand out, such as a control boundary on a tinted surface.

colors.name: color/border/brand
colors.description: Selected controls and active inputs, such as a selected radio card.

colors.name: color/border/brand/subtle
colors.description: Brand-tinted outlines, such as a brand badge border.

colors.name: color/border/danger
colors.description: Border of an invalid field.

colors.name: color/border/danger/subtle
colors.description: Outline of danger badges and error alerts.

colors.name: color/border/warning
colors.description: Border of a field with a warning.

colors.name: color/border/warning/subtle
colors.description: Outline of warning badges and alerts.

colors.name: color/border/success
colors.description: Border of a validated field.

colors.name: color/border/success/subtle
colors.description: Outline of success badges and alerts.

colors.name: color/border/info
colors.description: Border of an informational field or callout.

colors.name: color/border/info/subtle
colors.description: Outline of info badges and alerts.

colors.name: color/border/focus
colors.description: Focus ring color; used by the `focus/*` effect styles on 1.5.

colors.name: color/border/disabled
colors.description: Borders of disabled controls.

colors.name: color/surface/base
colors.description: Page background and the default background of cards and controls.

colors.name: color/surface/base/hover
colors.description: Rows, list items and secondary buttons under the pointer.

colors.name: color/surface/base/pressed
colors.description: Rows, list items and secondary buttons while pressed.

colors.name: color/surface/sunken
colors.description: Recessed areas: page sections behind cards, table headers, code blocks.

colors.name: color/surface/sunken/hover
colors.description: Recessed rows under the pointer.

colors.name: color/surface/raised
colors.description: Cards and panels that sit above the page; used with `elevation/raised`.

colors.name: color/surface/raised/hover
colors.description: Clickable cards under the pointer.

colors.name: color/surface/overlay
colors.description: Menus, popovers, dialogs and drawers; used with `elevation/overlay` and `elevation/modal`.

colors.name: color/surface/inverse
colors.description: Inverse surfaces such as tooltips and dark callouts.

colors.name: color/surface/brand-subtle
colors.description: Lightly tinted brand areas, such as a highlighted plan card.

colors.name: color/surface/brand-subtle/hover
colors.description: Tinted brand areas under the pointer.

colors.name: color/surface/brand-solid
colors.description: Solid brand sections such as a marketing banner; content on it uses the `on-brand` roles.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/solid
colors.description: Solid tone fill: primary buttons, solid badges, checked checkboxes, switch on.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/solid/hover
colors.description: The solid fill under the pointer.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/solid/pressed
colors.description: The solid fill while pressed.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/solid/selected
colors.description: A selected solid item, such as the active segment of a segmented control.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/solid/disabled
colors.description: Solid fills of disabled controls.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/subtle
colors.description: Tinted tone fill: subtle badges, tinted buttons, alert backgrounds.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/subtle/hover
colors.description: The tinted fill under the pointer.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/subtle/pressed
colors.description: The tinted fill while pressed.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/subtle/selected
colors.description: Selected rows and selected menu items.

colors.name: color/fill/{tone}/subtle/disabled
colors.description: Tinted fills of disabled controls.

colors.name: color/fill/none
colors.description: Transparent fill that keeps a layer bound, such as a ghost button at rest.

colors.name: color/fill/neutral/track
colors.description: Unfilled tracks: progress bars, sliders and the off state of switches.

colors.name: color/overlay/scrim
colors.description: Scrim behind dialogs and drawers that dims the page.

colors.name: color/shadow/ambient
colors.description: Soft, wide shadow layer that gives every elevation its spread.

colors.name: color/shadow/key
colors.description: Tighter, darker shadow layer that gives elevation its direction.

colors.name: color/shadow/edge
colors.description: Inner bottom edge of tactile controls (only when the tactile treatment is used).

colors.name: color/shadow/highlight
colors.description: Inner top highlight of tactile controls (only when the tactile treatment is used).

radius/none.description: Square corners on tables, full-bleed media and edges that meet.

radius/xs.description: Small parts inside controls, such as the checkbox box.

radius/sm.description: Nested parts such as menu items and tags inside inputs.

radius/control.description: Buttons, inputs, selects and every control the user operates.

radius/full.description: Pills, avatars, switches, dots and radio buttons.

border/width/default.description: Dividers and the outline of controls, cards and menus.

border/width/strong.description: Lines that must stand out, such as a control boundary on a tinted surface.

border/width/selected.description: Outlines of selected cards, segments and options.

motion/duration/instant.description: Changes that happen with no animation.

motion/duration/fast.description: Hover, press and color changes; anything leaving. Kept in Reduced because it is used for fades.

motion/duration/base.description: Small movements such as a switch thumb or a menu opening.

motion/duration/slow.description: Large movements such as a dialog or drawer entering.

motion/duration/loop.description: One rotation of a spinner; slower, not stopped, in Reduced.

motion/delay/tooltip.description: Wait before a tooltip appears on hover.

motion/delay/toast.description: Time before a toast dismisses itself.

motion/delay/debounce.description: Wait after typing before a search runs.
